title: A 19. századi európai regény: Puskintól Tolsztojig
grammar: Social & Psychological Portrayal: Ábrázol, bemutat, tükröz

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can explain Alexander Pushkin's Eugene Onegin and the concept of the 'superfluous man' (felesleges ember).
I can describe Charles Dickens's social realism in Oliver Twist and A Christmas Carol.
I can discuss Leo Tolstoy's War and Peace and Anna Karenina, alongside Dostoevsky's Crime and Punishment.
I can use Hungarian verbs of literary depiction (ábrázol, bemutat, tükröz) with accusative objects.
